title: MRR MethodRuling
description: docs/spec/08_RESEARCH_METHOD_KERNEL.md (status ACCEPTED, 2026-07-21) section 3's object table ('MethodRuling | the ruling that licenses claim language: which ceiling applies to which branch, and why; issued deterministically where rules suffice, by attributed human review where they do not | pending -> issued -> superseded'). Fifth of the six task-packets/K1-T01.yaml entities. 'ruled_ceiling' imports and reuses mrr.contracts.method_profile.ClaimCeiling/CLAIM_CEILING_ORDER verbatim, never redeclared. MRR-MTH-017 ('Claims above descriptive MUST carry an explicit scope of validity and at least one named non-applicability condition') is placed HERE rather than on Claim (task-packets/K1-T01.yaml derived_decisions/specification_gaps: schemas/claim.schema.json is outside this task's allowed_paths; whether Claim should ALSO carry its own copy is left to task-packets/K1-T02.yaml). 'ruling_basis' picks exactly one of deterministic_rule_reference / human_review, mirroring evidence-anchor.schema.json's own anchor_kind-picks-the-active-half pattern.

ruled_ceiling.description: Imported and reused verbatim from mrr.contracts.method_profile.ClaimCeiling (task-packets/K0-T01.yaml) — never redeclared.

scope_of_validity.description: MRR-MTH-017. Reuses common.schema.json#/$defs/scope verbatim, like QuestionModel.scope.

non_applicability_conditions.description: MRR-MTH-017: at least one named non-applicability condition, required non-empty exactly when ruled_ceiling is above 'descriptive' in CLAIM_CEILING_ORDER (associational_unadjusted and every stronger ceiling). A ruling at descriptive or below may declare an empty list.

ruling_basis.description: Discriminator picking exactly one of deterministic_rule_reference / human_review.

issued_by.description: The accountable decider for this ruling — distinct from baseObject.created_by, since a system process could persist a ruling on a human reviewer's behalf (mirrors VerificationResult.reviewer_id's own coexistence with created_by). Required unconditionally, even at 'pending'.

protocol_id.description: The governing MethodProtocol this ruling covers. A plain body field, never an edge; not validated to resolve to a locked MethodProtocol here (service-level, deferred).

applies_to_analysis.description: A free-string tag matching one entry of the governing MethodProtocol's own planned_analyses list. No first-class 'branch'/'analysis' object exists in this repository; this cross-object correspondence is not validated here (service-level, deferred).

status.description: Lifecycle status (spec 08 section 3's table: pending -> issued -> superseded).
